consumer: An engine LOS check such as map::sees(avatar_pos, target, range) asking the yes/no question 'does the avatar have a clear line of sight to this tile right now?' that gameplay (e.g. ranged-target eligibility) depends on
scope: point-to-point line of sight from the avatar's position to one given nearby tile within sight range (not a map region, not display memory)
decisive_source: src/map.cpp::map::sees(F,T,range) — computes and returns the boolean reachability/LOS predicate between two tiles within range, the authoritative yes/no the goal needs
divergence: A tile the avatar can actually see this turn (true map::sees) that pl_sees/'seen' reports false because it is range/memory-filtered for display (e.g. just outside the remembered-render radius or unseen this frame) — the display proxy diverges from the true LOS predicate
